title: Lord Shiva informs Rama about his father
introduction: Lord Shiva informs Rama that his father, Dasaratha, in an ethereal form and as a replica of his extinct personality, has arrived in an aerial car along with Indra, the lord of celestials. Shiva asks Rama and Lakshmana to pay their respects to the soul of Dasaratha and they respond in approaching him and offer their salutations. Dasaratha says he is overjoyed in seeing him, having defeated Ravana and having completed the exile for fourteen years. He asks Rama to return to Ayodhya, meet Bharata and get consecrated to the throne of Ayodhya. Dasaratha further advises Lakshmana and Seetha to continue to serve Rama, the supreme deity. Dasaratha returns to the abode of Indra, by the aerial car.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकोनविंशत्यधिकशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 119th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं राघवेण सुभाषितम् |
इदं शुभतरं वाक्यं व्याजहार महेश्वरः
verses.iast:
etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ rāghaveṇa subhāṣitam |
idaṃ śubhataraṃ vākyaṃ vyājahāra maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the auspicious words thus spoken by Rama, Lord Shiva the Supreme Lord thereupon delivered the following still more beautiful speech:

glosses.meaning: delivered the following still more beautiful speech:

verses.devanagari:
पुष्कराक्ष महाबाहो महावक्षः परन्तप |
दिष्ट्या कृतमिदं कर्म त्वया शस्त्रभृतां वर
verses.iast:
puṣkarākṣa mahābāho mahāvakṣaḥ parantapa |
diṣṭyā kṛtamidaṃ karma tvayā śastrabhṛtāṃ vara
verses.translation: "O lotus-eyed, long-armed, broad-chested, annihilator of enemies and excellent among those upholding the cause of virtue! Thank heaven! You accomplished this task."

glosses.meaning: among those upholding the cause of virtue!

verses.devanagari:
दिष्ट्या सर्वस्य लोकस्य प्रवृद्धं दारुणं तमः |
अपावृत्तं त्वया सङ्ख्ये राम रावणजं भयम्
verses.iast:
diṣṭyā sarvasya lokasya pravṛddhaṃ dāruṇaṃ tamaḥ |
apāvṛttaṃ tvayā sañkhye rāma rāvaṇajaṃ bhayam
verses.translation: "Fortunately has the fear born of Ravana - which increased the severe darkness on the entire world has been removed by you, on the battle-field, O Rama!"

verses.devanagari:
आश्वास्य भरतं दीनं कौसल्यां च यशस्विनीम् |
कैकेयीं च सुमित्रां च दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमातरम्
प्राप्य राज्यमयोध्यायां नन्दयित्वा सुहृज्जनम् |
इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले वंशं स्थापयित्वा महाबल
इष्ट्वा तुरगमेधेन प्राप्य चानुत्तमं यशः |
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं दत्त्वा त्रिदिवं गन्तुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
āśvāsya bharataṃ dīnaṃ kausalyāṃ ca yaśasvinīm |
kaikeyīṃ ca sumitrāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamātaram
prāpya rājyamayodhyāyāṃ nandayitvā suhṛjjanam |
ikṣvākUṇāṃ kule vaṃśaṃ sthāpayitvā mahābala
iṣṭvā turagamedhena prāpya cānuttamaṃ yaśaḥ |
brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā tridivaṃ gantumarhasi
verses.translation: "You are fit to go to the heaven, by comforting the depressed Bharata and the illustrious Kausalya as well as seeing Kaikeyi and Sumitra, the mother of Lakshmana having got the sovereignty of Ayodhya, bringing delight to your friends, stabilizing the back-bone in the race of Ikshvaku, getting excellent glory by performing a horse-sacrifice and by granting riches to Brahmanas."

verses.devanagari:
एष राजा विमानस्थः पिता दशरथस्तव |
काकुत्स्थ मानुषे लोके गुरुस्तव महायशाः
verses.iast:
eṣa rājā vimānasthaḥ pitā daśarathastava |
kākutstha mānuṣe loke gurustava mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: "This king Dasaratha, your father in this mortal world and the highly glorious as well as the venerable person, is seated in an aerial car, O Rama!"

glosses.meaning: the highly glorious and venerable person
is seated in an aerial car

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्रलोकं गतः श्रीमांस्त्वया पुत्रेण तारितः |
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा त्वमेनमभिवादय
verses.iast:
indralokaṃ gataḥ śrīmāṃstvayā putreṇa tāritaḥ |
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā tvamenamabhivādaya
verses.translation: "Having been delivered by you, his (godly) son, the glorious king obtained the abode of Indra the lord of celestials. you offer your respectful salutation to him, along with Lakshmana, your brother."

glosses.meaning: the abode of Indra the lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
महादेववचः श्रुत्वा काकुत्स्थः सहलक्ष्मणः |
विमानशिखरस्थस्य प्रणाममकरोत्पितुः
verses.iast:
mahādevavacaḥ śrutvā kākutsthaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ |
vimānaśikharasthasya praṇāmamakarotpituḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Shiva, Rama along with Lakshmana his brother, offered their salutation to their father, seated on the topmost part of an aerial car.

glosses.meaning: seated on the topmost part of an aerial car.

verses.devanagari:
दीप्यमानं स्वयां लक्ष्म्या विरजोअम्बरधारिणम् |
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा ददर्श पितरं प्रभुः
verses.iast:
dīpyamānaṃ svayAṃ lakṣmyā virajoambaradhāriṇam |
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā dadarśa pitaraṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The lord Rama along with Lakshmana his brother saw their father, who was blazing with his own splendour and clad in brilliant garments.

verses.devanagari:
हर्षेण महताविष्टो विमानस्थो महीपतिः |
प्राणैः प्रियतरं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं दशरथस्तदा
आरोप्याङ्कं महाबाहुर्वरासनगतः प्रभुः |
बाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वज्य ततो वाक्यं समाददे
verses.iast:
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭo vimānastho mahīpatiḥ |
prāṇaiḥ priyataraṃ dṛṣṭvā putraṃ daśarathastadā
āropyāñkaṃ mahābāhurvarāsanagataḥ prabhuḥ |
bāhubhyāṃ sampariṣvajya tato vākyaṃ samādade
verses.translation: Then the king Dasaratha the lord who was sitting in the aerial car, in an excellent seat, was filled with excessive delight to see his son (Rama), who was dearer to him than life. Placing him in his lap and embracing him in his arms, he thereupon commenced his speech as follows:

glosses.meaning: who was sitting in aerial car

verses.devanagari:
न मे स्वर्गो बहुमतः संमानश्च सुरर्षिभिः |
त्वया राम विहीनस्य सत्यं प्रतिशृणोमि ते
verses.iast:
na me svargo bahumataḥ saṃmānaśca surarṣibhiḥ |
tvayā rāma vihīnasya satyaṃ pratiśṛṇomi te
verses.translation: "O Rama! Separated from you, the heaven is not a liking to me, nor the respect given to me by the foremost of celestials. I am telling you the truth."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य त्वां निहतामित्रं दृष्ट्वा संपूर्णमानसम् |
निस्तीर्णवनवासं च प्रीतिरासीत्परा मम|
verses.iast:
adya tvāṃ nihatāmitraṃ dṛṣṭvā sampūrṇamānasam |
nistīrṇavanavāsaṃ ca prītirāsītparā mama |
verses.translation: "Today, there is a great joy for me, for having seen you, fully satisfied in your mind, now that your enemies have been destroyed and you have fully gone through the period of exile."

glosses.meaning: by whom the enemies have been destroyed
and having fully gone through the period of your exile.

verses.devanagari:
कैकेय्या यानि चोक्तानि वाक्यानि वदतां वर |
तव प्रव्राजनार्थानि स्थितानि हृदये मम
verses.iast:
kaikeyyA yAni coktAni vAkyAni vadatAṃ vara |
tava pravrAjanArthAni sthitAni hṛdaye mama
verses.translation: "O excellent among the eloquent! The words, which were uttered by Kaikeyi, with an aim to send you into exile, are still imprinted in my heart."

glosses.meaning: with an aim to send you into exile
are (still) imprinted mama hR^idayaani = in my heart.

verses.devanagari:
त्वां तु दृष्ट्वा कुशलिनं परिष्वज्य सलक्ष्मणम् |
अद्य दुःखाद्विमुक्तोअस्मि नीहारादिव भास्करः
verses.iast:
tvāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā kuśalinaṃ pariṣvajya salakṣmaṇam |
adya duḥkhādvimuktoasmi nīhārādiva bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: "Seeing you in a fine fettle with Lakshmana and hugging you today, I stand completely rid of sorrow - even as the sun is freed from mist."

verses.devanagari:
तारितोअहं त्वया पुत्र सुपुत्रेण महात्मना |
अष्टावक्रेण धर्मात्मा तारितो ब्राह्मणो यथा
verses.iast:
tāritoahaṃ tvayā putra suputreṇa mahātmanā |
aṣṭāvakreṇa dharmātmā tārito brāhmaṇo yathā
verses.translation: "O great-souled son! I have been redeemed by you, my worthy son, even as Kahola a brahmana was redeemed by Ashtavakra."

verses.devanagari:
इदानीं च विजानामि यथा सौम्य सुरेश्वरैः |
वधार्थं रावणस्येह विहितं पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.iast:
idānīṃ ca vijānāmi yathā saumya sureśvaraiḥ |
vadhārthaṃ rāvaṇasyeha vihitaṃ puruṣottamam
verses.translation: "O gently one! I recognize you now to be the Supreme person, duly enjoined here by the rulers of gods, for the destruction of Ravana."

glosses.meaning: O gentle one! vijaanaami = I recognize you

verses.devanagari:
सिद्धार्था खलु कौसल्या या त्वां राम गृहं गतम् |
वनान्निवृत्तं संहृष्टा द्रक्ष्यते शत्रुसूदन
verses.iast:
siddhārthā khalu kausalyā yā tvāṃ rāma gṛhaṃ gatam |
vanānnivṛttaṃ saṃhṛṣṭā drakṣyate śatrusUdana
verses.translation: "Blessed indeed is Kausalya, who will see you, the destroyer of your enemies, returned home from the forest."

verses.devanagari:
सिद्धार्थाः खलु ते राम नरा ये त्वां पुरीं गतम् |
राज्ये चैवाभिषिक्तं च द्रक्ष्यन्ति वसुधाधिपम्
verses.iast:
siddhārthāḥ khalu te rāma narā ye tvāṃ purīṃ gatam |
rājye caivābhiṣiktaṃ ca drakṣyanti vasudhādhipam
verses.translation: "Blessed indeed are those men, who will see you returned to the City of Ayodhya and consecrated on the throne as a lord of the earth."

glosses.meaning: as a lord of the earth.

verses.devanagari:
अनुरक्तेन बलिना शुचिना धर्मचारिणा |
इच्छेयं त्वामहं द्रष्टुं भरतेन समागतम्
verses.iast:
anuraktena balinā śucinā dharmacāriṇā |
iccheyaṃ tvāmahaṃ draṣṭuṃ bharatena samāgatam
verses.translation: "I desire to see you, re-united with the mighty Bharata, who is affectionate towards you, honest and virtuous."

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दशसमाः सौम्य वने निर्यापितास्त्वया |
वसता सीतया सार्धं लक्ष्मणेन च धीमता
verses.iast:
caturdaśasamāḥ saumya vane niryāpitāstvayā |
vasatā sītayā sārdhaṃ lakṣmaṇena ca dhīmatā
verses.translation: "O gentle one! You spent fourteen years, residing in the forest with Lakshmana and Seetha."

verses.devanagari:
निवृत्तवनवासोअसि प्रतिज्ञा सफला कृता |
रावणं च रणे हत्वा देवास्ते परितोषिताः
verses.iast:
nivṛttavanavāsoasi pratiGYā saphalā kṛtā |
rāvaṇaṃ ca raṇe hatvā devāste paritoṣitāḥ
verses.translation: "You completed the term of your exile. My pledge was implemented by you. The celestials too have been fully gratified, by your killing of Ravana in battle."

glosses.meaning: you completed the term of your exile

verses.devanagari:
कृतं कर्म यशः श्लाघ्यं प्राप्तं ते शत्रुसूदन |
भ्रातृभिः सह राज्यस्थो दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुहि
verses.iast:
kṛtaṃ karma yaśaḥ ślāghyaṃ prāptaṃ te śatrusUdana |
bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rājyastho dīrghamāyuravāpnuhi
verses.translation: "O the destroyer of enemies! A laudable act has been done and glory has been earned by you. Getting consecrated on the throne, may you attain a long life, along with your brothers."

verses.devanagari:
इति ब्रुवाणं राजानं रामः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत् |
कुरु प्रसादं धर्मज्ञ कैकेय्या भरतस्य च
verses.iast:
iti bruvāṇaṃ rājānaṃ rāmaḥ prāñjalirabravīt |
kuru prasādaṃ dharmaGYa kaikeyyā bharatasya ca
verses.translation: To Dasaratha, who was thus speaking, Rama with joined palms in salutation, submitted (as follows): "Be gracious to Kaikeyi and Bharata, O the knower of virtues!"

verses.devanagari:
सपुत्रां त्वां त्यजामीति यदुक्ता कैकयी त्वया |
स शापः कैकयीं घोरः सपुत्रां न स्पृशेत्प्रभो
verses.iast:
saputrāṃ tvāṃ tyajāmīti yaduktā kaikayī tvayā |
sa śāpaḥ kaikayīṃ ghoraḥ saputrāṃ na spṛśetprabho
verses.translation: You will remember those words spoken by you saying, I disown you, with your son (Bharata)'. May that terrific curse not touch Kaikeyi and her son, O Lord!"

verses.devanagari:
तथेति महाराजो राममुक्त्वा कृताञ्जलिम् |
लक्ष्मणं च परिष्वज्य पुनर्वाक्यमुवाच ह
verses.iast:
tatheti mahārājo rāmamuktvā kṛtāñjalim |
lakṣmaṇaṃ ca pariṣvajya punarvākyamuvāca ha
verses.translation: Saying 'May it be" to Rama who stood with joined palms embraced Lakshmana. Dasaratha again uttered the following words to Lakshmana:

verses.devanagari:
रामं शुश्रूषता भक्त्या वैदेह्या सह सीतया |
कृता मम महाप्रीतिः प्राप्तं धर्मफलं च ते
verses.iast:
rāmaṃ śuśrUṣatā bhaktyā vaidehyā saha sītayā |
kṛtā mama mahāprītiḥ prāptaṃ dharmaphalaṃ ca te
verses.translation: "A great gratification has been rendered to me and reward in the form of religious merit earned by you in that you served Rama and Seetha, the princess of Videha kingdom, with devotion."

verses.devanagari:
धर्मं प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ यशश्च विपुलं भुवि |
रामे प्रसन्ने स्वर्गं च महिमानं तथैव च
verses.iast:
dharmaṃ prāpsyasi dharmaGYa yaśaśca vipulaṃ bhuvi |
rāme prasanne svargaṃ ca mahimānaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: "Rama, being pleased with you, you will attain religious merit and extensive glory on earth, as also heaven and excellent power O knower of righteousness!"

verses.devanagari:
रामं शुश्रूष भद्रं ते सुमित्रानन्दवर्धन |
रामः सर्वस्य लोकस्य शुभेष्वभिरतः सदा
verses.iast:
rāmaṃ śuśrUṣa bhadraṃ te sumitrānandavardhana |
rāmaḥ sarvasya lokasya śubheṣvabhirataḥ sadā
verses.translation: "Happiness to you, O the augmentor of the joy of Sumitra, your mother! Serve Rama well. Rama forever is intent on advancing the interests of the entire world."

glosses.meaning: O the augmentor of the joy of Sumitra
on advancing the interests of the entire world.

verses.devanagari:
एते सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः |
अभिगम्य महात्मानमर्चन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.iast:
ete sendrāstrayo lokāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ |
abhigamya mahātmānamarcanti puruṣottamam
verses.translation: "These three worlds, including Indra Siddhas (a class of demi-gods) and great sages pay homage to the great-souled Rama as a Supreme person, on approaching him."

verses.devanagari:
एतत्तदुक्तमव्यक्तमक्षरं ब्रह्मनिर्मितम् |
देवानां हृदयं सौम्य गुह्यं रामः परन्तपः
verses.iast:
etattaduktamavyaktamakṣaraṃ brahmanirmitam |
devānāṃ hṛdayaṃ saumya guhyaṃ rāmaḥ parantapaḥ
verses.translation: "O great one! O the destroyer of adversaries! Rama has been spoken of as the unmanifest and the imperishable Brahama (the absolute), established by the Vedas, the heart of gods and the secret of all gods."

verses.devanagari:
अवाप्तं धर्मचरणं यशश्च विपुलं त्वया |
एनं शुश्रूषता भक्त्या वैदेह्या सह सीतया
verses.iast:
avāptaṃ dharmacaraṇaṃ yaśaśca vipulaṃ tvayā |
enaṃ śuśrUṣatā bhaktyā vaidehyā saha sītayā
verses.translation: "Having served him, along with Seetha with devotion, you obtained the reward of the practice of all virtues as also celebrity, abundantly."

glosses.meaning: him along with Seetha the princess of Videha kingdom
the reward of the practice of all virtues

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं राजा स्नुषां बद्धाञ्जलिं स्थिताम् |
पुत्रीत्याभाष्य मधुरं शनैरेनामुवाच ह
verses.iast:
ityuktvā lakṣmaṇaṃ rājā snuṣāṃ baddhāJṇjaliṃ sthitām |
putrītyābhāṣya madhuraṃ śanairenāmuvāca ha
verses.translation: Thus speaking to Lakshmana, the (former) king, addressing his daughter-in-law standing before him with joined palms as "My daughter", slowly and affectionately advised her as follows:

verses.devanagari:
कर्तव्यो न तु वैदेहि मन्युस्त्यागमिमं प्रति |
रामेण त्वद्विशुद्ध्यर्थं कृतमेतद्धितैषिणा
verses.iast:
kartavyo na tu vaidehi manyustyāgamimaṃ prati |
rāmeṇa tvadviśuddhyarthaṃ kṛtametaddhitaiṣiṇā
verses.translation: "No wrath indeed should be rendered by you towards Rama, for having repudiated you. This has been done by him, wishing for your welfare and in order to demostrate your purity."

glosses.meaning: and for the purpose of showing you purification.

verses.devanagari:
सुदुष्करमिदं पुत्रि तव चारित्रलक्षणम् |
कृतं यत्तेऽन्यनारीणां यशो ह्यभिभविष्यति|
verses.iast:
suduṣkaramidaṃ putri tava cāritralakṣaṇam |
kṛtaṃ yatte'nyanārīṇāṃ yaśo hyabhibhaviṣyati |
verses.translation: "This act (of entering into fire) which has been done by you and which reveals your true character, my daughter, is the most difficult task to perform for other ladies and will overshadow their illustriousness."

glosses.meaning: and which reveals your true character

verses.devanagari:
न त्वं सुभ्रु समाधेया पतिशुश्रूवणं प्रति |
अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यमेष ते दैवतं परम्
verses.iast:
na tvaṃ subhru samādheyā patiśuśrUvaṇaṃ prati |
avaśyaṃ tu mayā vācyameṣa te daivataṃ param
verses.translation: "You need not be instructed about the matter of rendering service to your husband. But, it is to be told certainly by me. He is your supreme deity."

glosses.meaning: about the matter of rendering service to your husband

verses.devanagari:
इति प्रतिसमादिश्य पुत्रौ सीतां तथा स्नुषाम् |
इन्द्रलोकं विमानेन ययौ दशरथो ज्वलन्
verses.iast:
iti pratisamādiśya putrau sītāṃ tathā snuṣām |
indralokaṃ vimānena yayau daśaratho jvalan
verses.translation: Having instructed thus to his sons and Seetha, the King Dasaratha who was born in Raghu dynasty went to the abode of Indra, the lord of celestials, by an aerial car.

glosses.meaning: who was born in Raghu dynasty
to the abode of Indra the lord of celestials

verses.devanagari:
विमानमास्थाय महानुभावः |
श्रिया च संहृष्टतनुर्नृपोत्तमः |
आमन्त्य्र पुत्रौ सह सीतया च |
जगाम देवप्रवरस्य लोकम्|
verses.iast:
vimānamāsthāya mahānubhāvaḥ |
śriyā ca saṃhṛṣṭatanurnṛpottamaḥ |
āmantyra putrau saha sītayā ca |
jagāma devapravarasya lokam |
verses.translation: With a satisfied self, Dasaratha the excellent king of noble-mindedness endowed with splendour, taking leave of his sons and Seetha and mounting the aerial car, went to the abode of Indra, the chief of gods.
